notes.title: Update Ver. 1.37
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
Thank you for enjoying Blade Chimera.
Today, we have updated to Ver. 1.37.

Ver. 1.37
Feature Changes

Shin can now dodge in the input movement direction while attacking.
When falling from a platform, there are now a few frames that allows jump input.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where performing certain actions during the fight against Akuru would prevent the player from progressing further.
Fixed a bug that allowed the Legendary Kushi-Katsu and Ultimate Ramen to be multiplied.
Fixed some minor bugs.

We hope you continue to enjoy Blade Chimera!

notes.title: Team Ladybug's First Original Metroidvania: Blade Chimera Out Now!
notes.content:
Dear all,

Today, we are proud to have released Blade Chimera, Team Ladybug's very first original Metroidvania!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750454/71d994cf25003cca1775534cce0bf2d6ae9370d0.png

Building upon feedback we received from players of Touhou Luna Nights and Record of Lodoss War -Deedlit in Wonder Labyrinth-, Blade Chimera has 3 fully original maps and a large variety of sidequests for you to complete. It's a longer, richer experience that any past Team Ladybug game. You could also try out the newest demo available on the Steam page!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750454/7cfcde4853a5bfc515d7cf33c7b2129f50374e2d.gif

One of the game's defining features is the ability to warp anywhere on the map, which is pretty unusual for a Metroidvania. It allows quick, convenient travelling across the large maps without trivializing movement.

Special Collaboration with the IGAvania Bloodstained—the Metroidvania New Generation Bundle!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750454/c27cc938de4682cfee6c3098ac097cb1bdabe9bd.png

Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night, one of the most iconic titles by IGA, the great founding father of the Metroidvania genre itself, is collaborating with us to create this bundle. The collaboration is scheduled to last until the end of February.

Actually, IGA, Shutaro, and Ladybug have actually talked in a "Metroidvania round table" before, where Ladybug reveals that he strives to emulate their work in his own. That was what paved the way for this collaboration.

Until today, the discussion was only transcribed in Japanese, but to commemorate this collaboration, we've gotten special permission from Famitsu to translate it into English and Simplified Chinese. The translations are available to read on the PLAYISM website, and there you can read about just how much Ladybug was influenced by Symphony of the Night.

Click here to read the article if you're interested!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750454/7e4e9a61d823ddb60cbd0dfc48311383bd6eb73f.gif

We've also received comments from IGA and Ladybug concerning the Metroidvania New Generation bundle, which are exclusively featured in the following Famitsu article. The comments are only available in Japanese, but you can't read them anywhere else, so we'll share the link with you anyway!

Click here to read a message from Ladybug and IGA! (Japanese only; available from 6 PM JST)

And here's the link to the collaborative bundle:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49181/

Special Bundle Deals and Presents!

What's more, WSS playground, the producer of Blade Chimera, is having a publisher sale right now, which makes the Team Ladybug Bundle a real steal!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20245/Team_Ladybug_Bundle/

If you enjoy the music of Blade Chimera, look no further than the Blade Chimera Bundle, which includes the game's soundtrack as well as the base game for a small discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49419/

Off Steam, we're distributing free emotes on our webpage and Discord server that you can use in your own servers and other messaging platforms. If you're interested in getting the emotes, you can download them on the PLAYISM page. Please make sure to check the Terms of Use!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750454/ac28156fb82bcb525ccce42451bab86edf46145f.jpg

We hope you'll enjoy Blade Chimera and continue to support Team Ladybug!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2671230/_/

notes.title: 9 Days Until Release! A Surprising Mystery Collab Bundle is Coming...
notes.content:
Dear all,

Happy New Year!
Thank you all for trying out the new demo we released in December, and for all the feedback you've given us. We've read each and every piece of feedback, and we're glad that so many of you enjoy the game!

There's only 9 days left before Blade Chimera releases, and preorders for the Nintendo Switch version have also started, featuring a preorder bonus as well.
On the Steam side, we're going to have a very excting collaborative bundle with a certain title!
The name of the bundle is "Metroidvania ??? ??? Bundle",
 and it will be available at release on January 16.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750454/6fbf2035db80762baaaa052f304d7cb59da872ca.png

We believe Metroidvania fans will love this bundle... so we'd love to hear your predictions! What could the other game be?!

Other than the collaborative bundle, we're also planning a Team Ladybug bundle for Ladybug fans, as well as a Blade Chimera bundle that contains the game and its original soundtrack.

We were happy to hear that many players enjoyed the music of the game, so we hope you enjoy the soundtrack (and the bundle) as well!

We will be working hard until the final minutes before release in order to deliver a great game to all of you. Please sit tight for just 9 more days!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750454/0a8462e08fa561c2861c1395561f4e8c8bc4ff26.gif

notes.title: Blade Chimera to Release on January 16, 2025!
notes.content:
Dear all,

Thank you for supporting Blade Chimera.
Today, we can finally announce our release date!

Blade Chimera will release on January 16, 2025 at 1:00 AM (PST)!

"We're currently brushing up the demo we made for Steam Next Fest back in June, and it will be ready for you to play within the month!

The new demo will offer even more places to explore, so even if you've played the previous demo, please try out the new demo too!"

We have also released a new trailer. Check that out too!

[previewyoutube=ZPJl5YXHylE;full][/previewyoutube]

Nominated for Best Overseas Game in the indiePlay Awards!

During WePlay Expo 2024, Blade Chimera was nominated for the event's indiePlay Award as Best Overseas Game!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750454/eedf1e2030205f9079cb61a6d0bbbb2b66a2dc4c.jpg

We're very pleasantly surprised, considering all we submitted was the demo since the game isn't out yet!
We're working hard to make sure the final quality of the game meets everyone's high expectations for it, so please wait just a little longer and look forward to release!

notes.title: Cyberpunk Metroidvania, Blade Chimera, Delay Annoucement
notes.content:
Dear all,

Team Ladybug's latest metroidvania, Blade Chimera, was previously set to release in August. 
However, it is with a heavy heart that we have decided to delay Blade Chimera's release date to allow for extra polishing and quality improvements. 
We will share any updates regarding the new release date as we carefully monitor development so please stay tuned.

We sincerely apologize to those who have been patiently waiting but we are working hard to further improve and elevate the quality of the game before delivering it to you all. We hope you continue supporting us and the developers by wishlisting Blade Chimera and please keep an eye out on our upcoming announcements.

Thank you all for your support and understanding during this time.

notes.title: The Producer Plays Blade Chimera + Transformation Action Showcase!
notes.content:
We will be hosting a two-part livestream of Blade Chimera, the newest metroidvania by Team Ladybug, the developers of Touhou Luna Nights and Record of Lodoss War-Deedlit in Wonder Labyrinth!

In the first section, we will be streaming a playthrough of the game's Steam Next Fest demo by Daichi Saito, the producer of WSS playground.

In the second section, we will introduce some actions you can perform with the help of the beautiful demon Lux and her other form, the mighty Lumina Sword. Shin can use Lux's ability to interfere with the past to perform all sorts of unique attacks and overcome obstacles. This action system built around the Lumina Sword is one of Blade Chimera's most iconic features!

Blade Chimera is a metroidvania, and there are some areas we won't be showing in the videos... so please download the demo to explore for yourself!

notes.title: Blade Chimera will release in August 2024!
notes.content:
Dear all,

Blade Chimera was originally planned to release in Spring 2024, but in order to further polish the game and improve on its quality, the release date has been postponed to August 2024. The game is chock-full of story and gameplay content alike, and Team Ladybug's signature pixel art is being further refined. We're terribly sorry for the delay, but we hope the improved Blade Chimera will be high-quality and be able to entertain a wide audience.

The newly released trailer showcases many new boss battles and gimmicks, all painstakingly designed by Team Ladybug. It offers a sneak peek into the world of the game... but in order to let more players get their hands on the actual game experience, Blade Chimera will be joining Steam Next Fest in June (next month!) with a public demo. Please check out the demo too when it releases! 

[previewyoutube=v72e4ymswpU;full][/previewyoutube]

Please wishlist the game and look forward to release!
